chunks: Verily in this was a sign, but most of them do not believe.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that most people did not believe despite clear signs?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse underscores the Shia scholarly distinction between mere intellectual recognition of divine signs and the transformative faith (iman) that leads to action. It highlights that despite the clarity of the prophets' miracles, the majority of the Quraysh remained obstinate, illustrating the principle that clear evidence alone does not guarantee belief without spiritual receptivity.
